name: Training compute
parameters: C FLOP; N parameters; D training tokens
source: Hoffmann et al., Chinchilla, arXiv:2203.15556; Kaplan et al., arXiv:2001.08361

name: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index
parameters: s_i percentage market share of firm i; range 0 to 10000
source: US DOJ and FTC Merger Guidelines 2023

name: Cost-weighted exposure
equation: X = sum over lines of ( w_i * L_i * (1 - S_i) )
parameters: w_i share of stage budget; L_i control leverage 0-1; S_i substitutability 0-1

name: Effective compute
parameters: alpha algorithmic efficiency multiplier, about 3x per year
source: Ho et al. 2024 via Epoch AI; Gundlach et al., arXiv:2511.23455 (3x per year)

name: Denial half-life
parameters: R ratio of required to accessible effective compute; alpha 3.0 per year; h hardware price-performance 1.3 per year
source: Own construction from E4 and Epoch AI hardware price-performance estimate

name: KV cache memory per token
parameters: L layers; H_kv key-value heads; d_head head dimension; b bytes per value
source: Kwon et al., arXiv:2309.06180; Austin et al., How To Scale Your Model ch. 4

name: Inference price decline
parameters: k price decline factor per year for fixed capability; median 50, range 9 to 900
source: Epoch AI LLM Inference Price Trends; a16z LLMflation
